# upcloud_kubernetes_kubeconfig (Ephemeral Resource)

Kubeconfig of a [Managed Kubernetes](https://upcloud.com/products/managed-kubernetes) cluster. Returns the cluster level kubeconfig, or if `authentication` is defined, a kubeconfig for users authenticating through the OIDC authentication issuer configuration of that name. The OIDC kubeconfigs use the `kubelogin` (`kubectl oidc-login`) plugin, which needs to be installed on the client, and do not include any long-lived credentials. Please refer to [Terraform documentation on sensitive data](https://www.terraform.io/language/state/sensitive-data) to keep the kubeconfig as safe as possible.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Get the cluster level kubeconfig
ephemeral "upcloud_kubernetes_kubeconfig" "cluster" {
  cluster = upcloud_kubernetes_cluster.example.id
}

# Get the kubeconfig for users authenticating through the OIDC issuer "example-issuer" of the cluster
ephemeral "upcloud_kubernetes_kubeconfig" "oidc" {
  cluster        = upcloud_kubernetes_cluster.example.id
  authentication = "example-issuer"
  audience       = "example-client-id"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required Attributes

- `cluster` (String) UUID of the cluster.

### Optional Attributes

- `audience` (String) Audience of the issuer to use as the OIDC client ID in the kubeconfig. Needs to match one of the audiences of the authentication issuer configuration. If left out, the first audience of the issuer is used. Can be defined only when `authentication` is defined.
- `authentication` (String) Name of the OIDC authentication issuer configuration (see `upcloud_kubernetes_cluster_authentication` resource) to get the kubeconfig for. If left out, the cluster level kubeconfig is returned.

### Read-Only

- `client_certificate` (String) TLS authentication client certificate, encoded (PEM). Not set for OIDC kubeconfigs.
- `client_key` (String, Sensitive) Key to pair with `client_certificate`, encoded (PEM). Not set for OIDC kubeconfigs.
- `cluster_ca_certificate` (String) TLS authentication root certificate bundle, encoded (PEM).
- `host` (String) Hostname of the cluster API. Defined as URI.
- `id` (String) ID of the kubeconfig. This is a combination of the cluster UUID, the name of the OIDC authentication, and the audience, separated with a `/`. The authentication and the audience are included only if they are defined.
- `kubeconfig` (String, Sensitive) Kubernetes config file contents for the cluster.
